t: The Milwaukee Shockwave 1/4" Hex Magnetic Bit Holder 60mm is a robust power tool accessory for secure bit retention. This durable steel bit holder is ideal for professional tradespeople using impact drivers and drills on demanding construction sites or workshop tasks. Its custom-engineered steel construction and optimised heat treatment provide maximum strength and flexibility. The Shockzone absorbs high torque, offering increased resistance to impact driving. A strong magnetic tip ensures fasteners are held securely, making it perfect for high-torque applications.
